title: Ekubo Protocol — IPayer Callback Payer Spoofing Analysis
loss_raw: **17 WBTC (~$1,356,033)** in this single tx; ~$1.4M total across the broader campaign
root_cause: `IPayer.pay` (selector `0x599d0714`) only checks `msg.sender == EkuboCore` but trusts an attacker-supplied `payer` field, allowing `transferFrom(payer, Core, amount)` against any wallet that pre-approved the extension.
